instruction.text: Fill in the gaps translating the words below.

hint.text:
biologisches Geschlecht – sex
soziales Geschlecht – gender
Patriarchat – patriarchy
Gleichheit / Gleichwertigkeit / Gleichstellung – equality
Privatsphäre / privater Bereich – private sphere
öffentliche Wahrnehmung – public perception
die Instrumentalisierung – instrumentalisation
Pflegeperson / Betreuer*in – carer
bekämpfen – to combat
häusliche Gewalt – domestic violence
unverhältnismäßig / überproportional – disproportionate
sexuelle Belästigung – sexual harassment
entkriminalisieren – to decriminalise
Abtreibungs-Gesetze – abortion laws
der Oberste Gerichtshof – Supreme Court

Netzwerk alter männlicher Freunde – old boy network
Lohnlücke zwischen Geschlechtern – gender pay gap

hint.label: Vocabulary list

atoms.b: In a ((patriarchy)), there is no ((equality)) between men and women.

atoms.a: privater Bereich, öffentliche Wahrnehmung, traditionelle Familienrolle
atoms.b: Women are often pushed towards a position in the ((private_sphere)) and, in ((public_perception)), are still expected to fulfil the ((traditional_family_role)).
However, feminist movements are trying to ((combat)) the typically female role of the ((carer)) and to move towards more gender equality in the workplace.

atoms.a: Lohnlücke zwischen Geschlechtern, Netzwerk alter männlicher Freunde
atoms.b: The ((gender_pay_gap)) is reinforced by the ((old-boy_network old_boy_network)), meaning that well-paid positions are given by men to their male friends.
Early feminist movements' major achievement was the ((right_to_vote)) for women. Women's rights movements continue to address topics such as ((abortion_laws)).
